turbo.max_boost_kpa.ref: 2026-11-20 (D55): derived, not measured. Full-load lambda fixed at 1.35 (common-rail diesels run near the smoke limit, ~1.3-1.4 at full load); max boost solved so the calibrated plant reproduces the published BSFC 235 g/kWh (config nominal_bsfc_g_kwh) at take-off, SL ISA (eta_i 0.402). Was 190.0 kPa / lambda 1.55, which gave BSFC ~165 and EGT ~206 C
